endWarning: End this session and clear all answers?
copyWarning: The clipboard and QR codes expose health information. Share only with the intended recipient.
importWarning: Verify that these answers concern the same patient. Replace clears current answers. Conflicting event IDs cannot be merged.
cameraDenied: Camera unavailable. Allow camera access in device settings or enter a QR chunk.
invalid: Invalid value. Check the value and unit.
transferError: Transfer rejected. Check version, chunks and values; reset to scan a different transfer.
conflict: Conflicting answer IDs. Replace the session or cancel.
draft: Development content — not for patient use
privacy: Answers stay in memory until the session ends or the app process closes. Clipboard and QR exports leave this protection. This draft is not clinically validated and does not replace an interpreter.
storageError: Settings could not be saved. Retry in Settings.
limit: Session limit reached. End or transfer this session.
